description: Move a thread to the inbox, the archive or the trash. It moves here at once, and in the mailbox itself on its next check. Mail you sent in it goes to Sent rather than the inbox, and drafts stay. Nothing is deleted: the trash is a folder, and undo_thread_move puts it back. Answers 409, with nothing moved, when a mailbox in the thread has no folder of that kind (folderMissing) or its mail server can't move messages from one folder to another (moveUnsupported: it lacks IMAP MOVE, so move the thread in that mailbox's own mail app). A key an owner limited to some mailboxes and agent inboxes changes only the thread's copies in those.

folder.description: Where the thread goes. The mail you sent in it goes back to Sent rather than the inbox, and drafts stay where they are.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

name: move_thread
title: Move a thread
